contents.analysis: Aggregate result, coverage, trajectory-scan tables, repository metadata, and release-redaction records derived from the release artifacts.
contents.assets: DepBench logo, icon, raster export, and responsive light/dark benchmark flow diagrams.
contents.custom_agents: Harbor agent adapters used by the provided Harbor config templates.
contents.governance: License, contribution, security, conduct, support, third-party notice, and open-source release checklist files in the repository root.
contents.packaging: pyproject.toml, setup.cfg, and setup.py define the installable release helpers and custom agent package.
contents.repro: Helper scripts and schema notes for downloading the Hugging Face dataset, reproducing task image pulls, oracle-solution verification, candidate-patch verification, release validation, Harbor execution, and trajectory scanning.
contents.results: Original and final per-trial metadata, configuration summaries, and rerun provenance.
contents.trajectories: Trajectory exports for the final selected trials in each reported benchmark configuration.
contents.verify_logs: Verifier stdout/CTRF exports aligned with the final selected trajectory rows.
